record: H-OG-PSP V4 smokes 1-3: private critic heads

smoke_2_function_preserving_init.THIS_is_the_equivalence_claim: V_0(h) == V_1(h) for identical trunk features h
smoke_2_function_preserving_init.and_THIS_is_legitimately_nonzero: z enters the critic TRUNK INPUT as well as selecting the head, so the same raw state yields different trunk features under different latents. Equally true of the shared critic. A non-zero value here is NOT failed initialisation.

smoke_3_real_ppo_wiring.path: model.values(global_state, z_idx) -- the same call PPO and GAE use

smoke_3_negative_control.description: all-z0 batch with routing deliberately flipped
smoke_3_negative_control.why: proves the check would catch z0 -> V1 or a dropped z_idx, rather than passing only because things happen to be correct

what_this_does_not_prove: that the treatment learns anything. Composition under a live trainer is a separate verification.
